messages:
customer-ops: Hey team — started seeing 403 when our app switches projects in the console and via the API after last night's maintenance. Happens for multiple users in the org. Error: \"permission denied\". Can you triage?

sam: Thanks for the report — can you paste one failing request id or curl call? Also which org/project id and approx time?

customer-ops: request-id `req_20260317_4572`, project `proj-aurora`, org `org-777`. Example curl:  ```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABCDEF\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/proj-aurora\"``` returns HTTP/1.1 403 and body `{"error":"forbidden","message":"insufficient_scope"}`. Started ~2026-03-17T02:10Z.

olivia: I see similar in audit logs — several service-bot token rotations ran 02:00-02:05Z. Tags show `service-rotate-job:v2`. Possibly role bindings were not carried over.

maya: Can you confirm whether users see 403 only in console UI or also via API?

customer-ops: Both. Console shows buttons greyed out when switching projects, API returns 403 on listing routes.

support-bot: Noted. Escalating to eng-oncall and SRE. @eng-oncall tagging. :rotating_light:

eng-oncall: Oncall here — digging in. Sam, can you share the full audit diff for the service account `svc-collector@org-777` around 02:00Z? Suspect role_bindings dropped.

sam: Pasted diff: ```- role_bindings: ["project.viewer","project.deployer"]
+ role_bindings: []
action: token.rotate
initiator: automation/service-rotate-job:v2```

sidharth: That matches a bug we saw in the rotation helper where a PR intended to sanitize metadata accidentally cleared role_bindings when token TTL < 1h. Working theory: rotation job created new token but didn't reapply RBAC.

maya: Short-term workaround: reattach roles to `svc-collector` and issue new key. Steps: 1) admin console -> Org -> Service accounts -> svc-collector -> Edit roles -> re-add `project.viewer` and `project.deployer`. 2) Force rotate token via UI or `POST /v1/service_accounts/svc-collector/keys` 3) Update app to use new key.

customer-ops: Doing that now. Will confirm.

customer-ops: Re-added roles and rotated token, both console and API look normal again. Thanks! :relieved:

eng-oncall: Great. Root cause: rotation job (v2) had an edge-case that cleared role_bindings when it used the fast path for short-lived keys. I've filed ENG-6142 to revert the fast-path and add tests.

sam: We've also re-run rotation for all orgs that had jobs between 02:00-02:10Z and verified bindings; opened a support bulk-change ticket for affected customers.

sidharth: Patch scheduled for 2026-03-18 03:00Z UTC to ensure role_bindings are persisted during token rotate. Will monitor.

maya: ACTIONS:
- Customer workaround confirmed (re-add roles + rotate key).
- Eng fix PR in review (ENG-6142).
- Bulk re-rotate for affected orgs done by support team.

customer-ops: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please keep us posted on the permanent fix so we can close our internal incident.

eng-oncall: Will update this thread after deploy and monitor for any regression. Tagging @sre for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
